super_families.SF6: interpretation, transmission, record and rule structure

target_structures.TS-closed-set-vacancy: a closed set of positions or functions in which one is unowned or empty
target_structures.TS-reciprocal-loop: enabling and constraining relations form a loop, so a local fix moves the problem elsewhere
target_structures.TS-condition-chain: an outcome needs upstream conditions; the intervention point is not where the symptom appears
target_structures.TS-standpoint-conditional: a claim holds only under omitted conditions (scale, time, definition, standpoint)
target_structures.TS-explanation-plurality: disagreeing explanations answer different kinds of why
target_structures.TS-coupled-periodicity: two periodic processes coincide; trouble occurs at the joint phase
target_structures.TS-reception-gap: good expression fails because of the receiver's state at reception
target_structures.TS-whole-part-mirroring: a local part carries the pattern of the whole at several scales
target_structures.TS-combinatorial-gap: dimensions are never crossed; unseen combinations hide gaps
target_structures.TS-process-decomposition: an undifferentiated account hides different process types
target_structures.TS-layered-origin: visible products come from upstream layers; observer and process are mixed
target_structures.TS-binary-trap: a question is trapped in a two-valued frame or a malformed predicate
target_structures.TS-dispute-location: parties dispute different kinds of issue (fact, definition, quality, procedure)
target_structures.TS-seasonal-phase: coarse phases hide finer phase boundaries
target_structures.TS-temporal-shape: a process has content but no temporal shape (pacing, acceleration, release)
target_structures.TS-role-relation-mismatch: claimed roles differ from enacted functions in relation-conditioned conduct
target_structures.TS-threshold-crossing: a crossing has separation, a liminal state and incorporation that can fail
target_structures.TS-center-periphery-access: nested boundaries mediate access between outside and center
target_structures.TS-route-network: branching routes, bypasses and handoff continuity that a flat graph hides
target_structures.TS-provenance-chain: content and its transmission path are separate; chains branch and converge
target_structures.TS-argument-structure: a compressed argument hides its reason, rule and application steps
target_structures.TS-norm-conflict-unit: prescriptive text segmented by action and purpose; apparent norm conflicts
target_structures.TS-rule-scope-blocking: inherited rule context and general/specific blocking decide the outcome
target_structures.TS-record-flattening-loss: a structured record loses information when flattened
target_structures.TS-sequence-fidelity: an ordered sequence must survive transformation with boundaries intact
target_structures.TS-indexed-analogy: a compact signature opens a large corpus of non-local analogies
target_structures.TS-axis-vs-level: independent axes describe the problem better than levels
target_structures.TS-mediation-whole-concrete: what mediates between an abstract whole and a concrete manifestation
target_structures.TS-objection-coverage: a proposed determination risks leaving materially different objections unanswered
target_structures.TS-stable-index-rebinding: a stable ordered index is reused while version-specific content is rebound and reconstructed
target_structures.TS-typed-condition-network: several heterogeneous condition modes converge, fan out, or interact around one target state

tier_definitions.A: tested already or adopted with an obvious matched target; extend with matched tasks and a larger task count
tier_definitions.B: new target structure that is plantable, appears in natural work, and belongs to an empty or unique operation family; bring in next
tier_definitions.C: technical structure whose distinctness from an ordinary practice is unproven; test distinctness before value
tier_definitions.D: near neighbor or modest marginal family gain; use as controls
tier_definitions.E: lineage, medical or living-tradition constraints; hold until profile and source gates are met
